messages:
Marta G: Heads-up — nightly model-refresh + benchmark run on staging FAILED (run 3412). bench-suite timed out after ~45m, lots of 504s hitting inference-gateway. @Ryan L @Nate P can you take a look? https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/3412
ci-bot: Test run 3412 summary: bench/throughput_smoke failed 8/10; first failure at step 23. Artifacts: /artifacts/3412/bench.log /artifacts/3412/gateway.log
Ryan L: On it. Can someone paste the failing bench.log and gateway log tail? I'll try a bisect across model commits. If infra needs a rerun ping me.
Nate P: Looking at infra metrics — staging-gpu-3 had a memory spike + retries at ~02:15 UTC, several pods OOMKilled. Kube events reference launcher crashloop. Rerunning nightly with node isolation now.
Marta G: Thanks. I also uploaded a quick bisect helper branch: https://git.redwood/model-refresh/compare/bisect-3412. Suggest run: `./tools/bisect.sh --range v1.3.7..v1.4.2 --test bench/throughput_smoke`
Ryan L: Got the logs. gateway.log shows repeated 504s and connection resets. bench.log shows timeouts after 30s per worker. Trying local repro with harness and enabling long-seq flag (bench --seq 1024) to reduce flakiness.
infra-bot: Rerun queued: nightly-refresh-3412 (isolated nodes allocation) — started at 1767890300.
Ryan L: Bisect progress: narrowed down to commits between v1.3.9 and v1.4.1. Repro locally against model@v1.4.0 — pinned commit 0a7f2b. Suspect quant-kernel change. Opening draft PR to revert commit: https://git.redwood/model-refresh/pull/482
Marta G: Please add the bench artifact and tag me. If rollback on staging fixes it we can promote. :thumbsup:
DevOps Squad: FYI we also had an egress/transit blip at ~02:10 UTC affecting one AZ, triggered extra gateway 504s. Monitoring shows it cleared ~02:25. Could be contributing factor.
Ryan L: After rollback to model@v1.3.9 + isolated rerun the nightly bench passes. Seems like a combination: kernel change + transient egress blip amplified failures. Closing the immediate incident. I'll follow up with a short postmortem and link to the bisect PR.
Marta G: Awesome — thanks everyone. If anyone sees recurrence re-open thread or DM.
ci-bot: Marking run 3412 as resolved (note: rerun id 3412-r2 passed).
